_about: How addresses work (engine/addresses.py): in Manhattan, Fifth Avenue splits the numbered streets into East and West (E 42nd St, W 42nd St), and their numbers count up away from Fifth. Below Washington Square the split is at Broadway and the Bowery, so only streets within 400 m of Fifth count. The card names the side in Manhattan only (city.json card.address.within) and explains the other boroughs' systems in words. Manhattan's East/West streets come from build.py (streets_ew).
